nodes.label: Display name "Bucktrail" vs technical project name "MoneyTracker"
nodes.rationale: App is displayed to users as "Bucktrail" (INFOPLIST_KEY_CFBundleDisplayName) for branding, while the Xcode project/folder/bundle id remain "MoneyTracker" so code and docs keep a stable internal identity.

nodes.label: Business model: one-time purchase (€4,99) + future optional Premium subscription
nodes.rationale: In a subscription-dominated market, a one-time payment is used as a trust signal; a future optional €1,99/mese Premium tier is planned for bank connection, AI coach, cross-device sync, family mode.

nodes.label: Privacy radicale / Completamente offline positioning
nodes.rationale: Core differentiator: zero server dependency, no shutdown risk, no shared data, no ads/tracking — positions the app against subscription-based competitors.

App Group fix: back-tap/Siri expenses saved into an invisible sandbox store
nodes.rationale: AddExpenseIntent ran out-of-process without an App Group entitlement, so it opened a different sandbox container than the main app; SharedStore.swift adds group.com.matteo.moneytracker.shared plus a one-time legacy-store migration so both processes share the same SQLite store.

nodes.label: Fix: local data wiped on passive session loss, replaced by stale Supabase snapshot
nodes.rationale: MoneyTrackerApp called SyncService.clearLocalData() reactively whenever auth.isLoggedIn went false, which also fires on passive session loss (expired refresh token, flaky network), not just explicit logout; fix moves clearLocalData() to the explicit logout button only, after pushing pending changes, and hardens pull() to not delete transactions still marked dirty.

nodes.label: Fix: recurring transactions backfill missed periods instead of only current one
nodes.rationale: processRecurring() previously generated only the current period's occurrence on each foreground trigger, so an occurrence was lost forever if the app wasn't opened exactly at the period boundary; fix backfills all missing occurrences up to a safety cap of 60 per template and switches lookup to a targeted fetch by templateId instead of a fixed 2-month window.

nodes.label: Fix: Double→Decimal migration precision (SchemaMigration.swift)
nodes.rationale: V1→V2 migration used Decimal(Double), freezing the imprecise binary expansion (19.99 became 19.98999999999999488 forever); fix converts via the shortest textual representation, Decimal(string: String(value)), and propagates migration errors instead of swallowing them with try?.

nodes.label: New App Icon design (minimal ascending bars, gold/amber accent)
nodes.rationale: Replaced the old black/white bar+line-with-dots icon with cleaner ascending bars, keeping green/red reserved for in-app balances by using a distinct gold/amber accent color; added missing dark and tinted iOS 18+ icon variants.

nodes.label: Statistics trend: bar+line → side-by-side BarMark redesign
nodes.rationale: Replaced the "Uscite" bars + "Entrate" dotted-line comparison with two side-by-side BarMarks per month for readability, especially when income was recurring with similar amounts; removed the now-dead isDot parameter of legendItem.

nodes.label: Account balance correction via "Rettifica saldo" adjustment transaction
nodes.rationale: Editing an account's current balance previously overwrote initialBalance incorrectly on accounts with history; fix now creates a dated adjustment transaction for just the difference, preserving historical transactions while landing on the exact entered value.

nodes.label: Fix: recurring engine now also runs on foreground return, not just cold launch
nodes.rationale: processRecurring() was invoked only inside a .task tied to ContentView's first mount (cold launch); users keeping the app alive across a month change never got new occurrences until they force-quit; fix triggers on scenePhase == .active with a daily guard to avoid redundant runs.

nodes.label: "Fissi del mese" Home card (fixed expense/income totals)
Fix: transfer deletion confirmation dialog not firing inside "Trasf." section
nodes.rationale: The confirmationDialog was attached only to the root NavigationStack hub view, not the pushed sub-list view actually on top when inside Transfers, so it stayed pending; fix extracts the modifier and attaches it to both the hub and subListContent(for:).

nodes.label: DS.positive/DS.negative semantic colors + DS.signColor(_:)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for sign-based coloring across balances, statistics, and rows; transfers are deliberately kept neutral because they are not a real gain/loss.

nodes.label: Fix: recurring engine generated a duplicate occurrence for the template's own period
nodes.rationale: The engine didn't account for the template itself already covering its own period since templates are excluded from the normal transaction fetch; fix adds an explicit check that skips generation when the template's date already falls in the current period.

nodes.label: Onboarding tour rewrite: per-tab icon spotlight → 16 element-level steps
Fix: Level-2 contextual mini-tours never appeared
nodes.rationale: TourOverlayView was mounted only while tourManager.isActive was true (overview running), but Level-2 ContextualHints fire after the overview ends, when the view no longer existed; fix mounts on isActive || activeHint != nil and adds a second trigger on onChange(of: tourManager.isActive).

nodes.label: Fix: back-tap/Siri transactions disappeared after save (markTransactionDirty)
nodes.rationale: AddExpenseIntent/AddIncomeIntent run in a separate process; their ctx.save() didn't trigger the ModelContext.didSave notification observed by SyncService.recordChanges() in the main process, so the transaction was never marked dirty and got deleted on the next push/pull as if deleted on another device; fix adds SyncService.markTransactionDirty(_:) called explicitly by both Intents after ctx.save().

nodes.label: Nightly test automation (run_nightly_tests.sh + LaunchAgent, 4:00 AM)
nodes.rationale: A LaunchAgent runs XCUITest on simulator nightly; on failure it invokes Claude Code headless to analyze and fix the code, retries up to 5 times, writes report_notturno.md, and opens a PR — automating regression triage outside normal working hours.
